description: Zcash chain state plus the distribution of all six value pools, in one call. When to use: how much ZEC sits in each shielded pool, the shielded share of supply, and whether the ZEC node is caught up. Do not use: we do not index Zcash transactions or wallets; for node peers and disk usage call chain_status. Returns: blocks/headers/estimated_height/chain_supply/difficulty/size_on_disk_gb, node_value_pools, pools[] with {pool, balance, share_of_supply_pct, delta_1h, delta_24h}, shielded_total, shielded_pct.
name: zec_get_pool_status
